quotes.name: Desmond Morton
quotes.quote: Honestly, the coaches haven't given me a clear answer yet. They know I've shown I can play at this level, but with Danny locked in center and Vladimir coming off the year he had, it's a real squeeze for left. I'm just trying to control what I can—show up, work, and let my play make the case. I know Frank and J.R. are pushing too, so it's not something I lose sleep over. The team's got a good problem, and whoever gets the spot, we're all pulling the same direction.

quotes.name: Frank Reyna
quotes.quote: Honestly, I don't think about separating myself from Desmond or JR. I think about what I bring that they don't. They've both proven they belong, no question. But I'm a power bat, and in this ballpark, that plays. I've shown I can do it at this level. The way I see it, the decision isn't about who's better — it's about what the lineup needs. And I'm going to make sure that answer is me.

quotes.name: Vladimir Gonzalez
quotes.quote: Honestly, the vibe is a lot less tense than you'd think. We all know the business side of it — somebody's gonna get moved or sent down, that's just how it goes. What I tell the young guys is you can't control what Paulson decides. You just control how you show up. And truth be told, it's a good problem for the A's to have. Means we got depth, and that's how you win. I earned my spot, sure, but I remember what it was like trying to crack a crowded room. You just hope the decision gets made quick so whoever it is lands somewhere they can play.
